locations.rationale: Quoted forward-reference return annotation "User" on the classmethod guest. Under PEP 484 semantics this string annotation is evaluated as a type expression whose identifier resolves to the class User declared in this module; it is a semantic type reference, not documentation text.

Token User in 'from .models import User as Account'. It resolves to shop.models.User, but it is the explicit import binding token of the re-export construct, so under the bindings_optional policy it is classified optional.

Alias token Account in 'from .models import User as Account'. It is the re-export alias binding through which the class is exposed; as a re-export binding token it is optional under bindings_optional, and it is not an exact-name User token.

Account in 'from shop import Account' resolves to the alias binding declared in src/shop/__init__.py, a distinct declaration name; it is not an exact-name User token, so it is not part of the required set for User.
Account in 'Account.guest()' resolves to the imported alias binding, not to the exact-name User declaration token; alias references are usages of the alias, not required usages of User.
Account in 'Account.format_name("ada")' resolves to the imported alias binding, not to the exact-name User declaration token; alias references are usages of the alias, not required usages of User.
